webhooks.name: connection-notebook.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Notebook (kubeflow.org/v1) create and update requests, parses the opendatahub.io/connections annotation to resolve referenced Secrets, validates they exist in the notebook's namespace and the requesting user has 'get' permission on them via SubjectAccessReview, then injects or removes those secrets as envFrom entries in the notebook's first container.

webhooks.name: hardwareprofile-notebook-injector.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Notebook create/update requests and injects hardware profile settings (resource requests/limits, node selectors, and tolerations) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR into the notebook's pod template. On profile changes or removal, it cleans up previously applied scheduling settings to ensure the notebook reflects the currently referenced (or no) hardware profile.

issues: Implicit informer for corev1.Secret via client.Get at internal/webhook/notebook/mutating.go:322 (cluster-wide, OOM risk). This bypasses cache filters and creates a full cluster-wide watch

No GOMEMLIMIT set in deployment (Go GC cannot pressure-tune). Set GOMEMLIMIT to 80-90% of container memory limit for optimal GC behavior

fields.name: ManagementState
fields.doc: managementState indicates whether this component should be managed by the operator. Set to one of the following values: - "Managed" : the operator is actively managing the component and trying to keep it active. It will only upgrade the component if it is safe to do so - "Removed" : the operator is actively managing the component and will not install it, or if it is installed, the operator will try to remove it Valid values are "Managed" and "Removed".
